fun_facts: Bryce Young was born in Pasadena, California.
Before playing for Alabama, Bryce Young came from Mater Dei High School in Santa Ana, California.
Bryce Young became the first Alabama quarterback to win the Heisman Trophy.
In 2021, Bryce Young set Alabama single-season records with 4,872 passing yards and 47 passing touchdowns.
In his first start, Bryce Young set Alabama records for passing yards and touchdowns, throwing for 344 yards and four touchdowns.

Open Extended Reactions

[Bryce Young](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4685720/bryce-young) made history Saturday night as the first [Alabama Crimson Tide](https://www.espn.com/college-football/team/_/id/333/alabama-crimson-tide) quarterback to [win the Heisman Trophy](https://www.espn.com/college-football/story/_/id/32847065/quarterback-bryce-young-awarded-heisman-trophy-giving-alabama-football-back-back-winners) .
citations.title: Bryce Young achieves multiple historical marks with Heisman Trophy win - ESPN

excerpts:
A two-year starter at Alabama, Young put up dizzying numbers as a college signal-caller, generating 8,200 passing yards and 79 TDs with 12 INTs in 27 games with the Crimson Tide from 2021 to 2022.

During his 2021 Heisman Trophy campaign, Young set Alabama single-season records with 4,872 passing yards and 47 passing TDs. He won the Davey O’Brien and Manning Awards as the nation’s top QB and was named a first-team All-American and SEC Offensive Player of the Year.
citations.title: Panthers select Alabama QB Bryce Young with No. 1 overall pick in 2023 NFL Draft | Latest NFL News, Analysis & Updates | NFL.com

excerpts:
Alabama's quarterback proved historic as he set a school record for passing touchdowns and yards in a debut as a starter in Saturday's [44-13 win](https://www.espn.com/college-football/game/_/gameId/401281942) over Miami.

Young, a sophomore, threw for 344 yards and four touchdowns. He completed 27 of 38 passes with no interceptions.

"It's a blessing, for sure," Young said of joining the Alabama record books.
citations.title: QB Bryce Young sets Alabama Crimson Tide record in debut with 4 passing TDs - ESPN
